Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes,ctypes.util,struct
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
D=128
buf=bytearray(D)
def be16(o,v): buf[o:o+2]=struct.pack('>H',v)
def be32(o,v): buf[o:o+4]=struct.pack('>I',v)
be32(0,0x00050000); be32(4,0); be16(8,1); be16(10,0); be32(12,16)
be32(16,0); be16(20,42); be16(22,50); be16(24,10); buf[30]=1; buf[34]=0xff
be32(58,66); be32(62,D); be32(78,8)
# first 86 literals, match len 4 via offset 0 holes, final 38 literals
N=86; rem=D-(N+4)
prefix=bytes(buf[:N]); suffix=bytes(buf[N+4:])
s=bytes([0xf0,N-15])+prefix+b'\x00\x00'+bytes([rem<<4])+suffix
out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*D,D); r=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(s),out,len(s),D,D)
print('stream len',len(s),'ret',r,'holes',out.raw[82:94].hex(),'okpref',out.raw[:N]==prefix,'oksuf',out.raw[N+4:]==suffix)
PY
